title: Universal Life Insurance Service Desk Rules: Grace Period and Lapse
content:
## Rule

When, on a monthly anniversary, the cash surrender value of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is less than the monthly deduction, the policy enters the grace period, unless the no-lapse guarantee holds it in force. The grace start date is that monthly anniversary, and the grace period lasts the tier's grace period, 61 calendar days on every tier.

**Time limit for the cure.** The cure premium must be received no later than the last day of grace, which is the grace start date plus the grace period days. The last day of grace is found by adding the grace period length in calendar days to the grace start date; a premium received on that day is in time. The grace start date is read from the policy record.

**The cure premium.** The cure premium is set on the grace notice and recorded on the policy as the grace cure premium. It is the monthly deductions on every monthly anniversary from the grace start date through the last day of grace, plus the tier's further months of deductions (3 on every tier) at the current monthly deduction, less any positive cash surrender value at the grace start date, divided by one less the tier's premium load percentage up to target, rounded to the cent.

**Outcome.**

| Cure premium credited | Result |
|---|---|
| In time (on or before the last day of grace) | The policy returns to in force |
| Not in time | The policy lapses on the day after the last day of grace; any loan is extinguished against the account value, and no value is payable |

A death during the grace period is covered, and the unpaid deductions are taken from the proceeds.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

Grace start date 1 March. Adding 61 calendar days gives a last day of grace of 1 May.

| Cure premium received | In time? |
|---|---|
| 30 April | Yes |
| 1 May (the last day of grace) | Yes |
| 2 May | No; the policy lapsed on 2 May |

## Worked cure premium (hypothetical)

An Ashgrove Protection UL (load up to target 6%) on which the monthly anniversaries fall on the 1st enters grace on 1 March; the deductions on 1 March, 1 April and 1 May are $200.00 each and the current monthly deduction is $200.00; the cash surrender value at the grace start date was $150.00. The cure premium is $600.00 plus three further months of $200.00, $1200.00, less $150.00, which is $1050.00, divided by 0.94: $1117.02.
